issue_request: FHIR-6957 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification PA change request from the 2015 May ballot asking to change old EpisodeOfCare.CareTeam.member cardinality from 0..1 to 0..*. The final resolution said the functionality is now covered by the CareTeam resource and EpisodeOfCare can reference multiple CareTeam resources.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-6957 source commit was found. Current source already represents the intended model through active CareTeam and EpisodeOfCare resources: EpisodeOfCare.careTeam is 0..* Reference(CareTeam), and CareTeam supports multiple participants. A later FHIR-23843 rename changed EpisodeOfCare.team to EpisodeOfCare.careTeam, but one active managingOrganization comment still referenced the old path.
additional_context: FHIR-23843 is already represented on the combined branch, so no duplicate FHIR-23843 commit was published. FHIR-44683 later confirmed that repeating EpisodeOfCare.careTeam is intentional and added explanatory text about distinguishing teams by CareTeam.period or CareTeam.category. Focused Zulip and Confluence searches found no direct FHIR-6957 discussion or conflicting community evidence.
